name: Jinx (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. Round Start: Draw 1. Each round, the first time I level up or you empty your hand, create a Super Mega Death Rocket! in hand.

name: Teemo (level 2)
text: Keywords: Elusive. Nexus Strike: Double the Poison Puffcaps in the enemy deck (plants 5 minimum).

name: Heimerdinger (level 2)
text: Keywords: Imbue. When you play a spell, create a Fleeting Turret in hand with equal cost. Grant it +1|+1 and it costs 0.

name: Ezreal (level 2)
text: Keywords: Elusive, Imbue. Nexus Strike: Create a Fleeting Mystic Shot in hand. When you play a spell, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus. If it targeted an enemy, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus instead.

name: Anivia (level 2)
text: Keywords: Last Breath. Attack: Deal 2 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus. Last Breath: Revive me transformed into Eggnivia.

name: Ashe (level 2)
text: Keywords: Missing Translation. Attack: Frostbite the strongest enemy. Enemies with 0 Power can't block.

name: Braum (level 2)
text: Keywords: Challenger, Regeneration. When I survive damage, summon a Mighty Poro.

name: Spider Queen Elise (level 2)
text: Keywords: Fearsome, Challenger, Missing Translation. Other Spider allies have Challenger and Fearsome.

name: Hecarim (level 2)
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. When I level up, grant your Nexus "Ephemeral allies have +3|+0". Attack: Summon 2 attacking Spectral Riders.

name: Kalista (level 2)
text: Keywords: Fearsome. Each round, the first time I attack revive an attacking Ephemeral copy of the strongest dead allied follower. This round, we're bonded and it takes damage for me.

name: Thresh (level 2)
text: Keywords: Challenger. The first time I attack this game, summon another attacking champion from your deck or hand.

name: Vi (level 2)
text: Keywords: Challenger, Tough. When I strike a unit while attacking, deal 5 to the enemy Nexus.

name: Gangplank (level 2)
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. When I'm summoned or Round Start: Summon a Powder Keg. Attack: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.

name: Miss Fortune (level 2)
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. When allies attack, deal 1 three times to all battling enemies and the enemy Nexus.

name: Fizz (level 2)
text: Keywords: Imbue. When you play a spell, stop all enemy spells and Skills targeting me and give me Elusive this round. Nexus Strike: Create a Chum the Waters in hand.

name: Twisted Fate (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. Each round, the first 3 times you play a card, I play a Destiny Card.

name: Nautilus (level 2)
text: Keywords: Tough, Fearsome, Missing Translation. Sea Monster allies cost 4 less.

name: Sejuani (level 2)
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. Play: Give an enemy Frostbite and Vulnerable this round. Each round, the first time you damage the enemy Nexus, Frostbite all enemies.

name: Swain (level 2)
text: Keywords: Fearsome, Overwhelm. When you deal non-combat damage to the enemy Nexus, Stun the strongest backrow enemy. Nexus Strike: Deal 3 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.

name: Quinn (level 2)
text: Keywords: Scout. Attack: Summon Valor Challenging the strongest enemy.

name: Maokai (level 2)
text: Keywords: Regeneration. When I level up, Obliterate the enemy deck, leaving 4 non-champions. Round Start: Summon a Sapling.

name: Lee Sin (level 2)
text: Keywords: Imbue. When you play a spell, give me Challenger this round. If you play another, give me Barrier this round. I Dragon's Rage enemies that I Challenge.

name: Riven (level 2)
text: When I'm summoned, if you have the attack token, or when you gain the attack token, Reforge. Each round, the first time you increase my Power, grant me that much Power.

name: Tahm Kench (level 2)
text: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create an An Acquired Taste in hand. Attack: Obliterate my Captured enemies and release my allies.

name: Aphelios (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack, Missing Translation. Nightfall: Pick a Moon Weapon to create in hand. Each round, the first time you play 2 other cards or Round Start: Create the Phased Moon Weapon in hand if you don't already have one. Your Moon Weapons cost 1 less.

name: Diana (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. Nightfall or when you activate another Nightfall: Give me +2|+0 and Challenger this round.

name: Soraka (level 2)
text: Keywords: Support. Each round, the first time you heal a damaged ally, draw 1. Support: Fully heal me and my supported ally.

name: Zoe (level 2)
text: Keywords: Elusive, Missing Translation. When I level up, grant your Nexus "When you summon an ally, grant its keywords to all allies." Nexus Strike: Create a Behold the Infinite that costs 0 in hand.

name: Aurelion Sol (level 2)
text: Keywords: Fury, SpellShield, Missing Translation. Play: Invoke a Celestial card that costs 7 or more. Round Start: Create a random Celestial card in hand. Your Celestial cards cost 0.

name: Leona (level 2)
text: Keywords: Challenger. Daybreak or when you activate another Daybreak: Stun the strongest enemy and give me Barrier this round.

name: Taric (level 2)
text: Keywords: Support. Support: My supported ally and I can't take damage or die this round. Copy the last spell you played on only me this round onto that ally (It can't be copied again).

name: Viktor (level 2)
text: Keywords: Augment, Missing Translation. Your created cards cost 1 less. When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create a Hex Core Upgrade in hand.

name: Nocturne (level 2)
text: Keywords: Fearsome, Missing Translation. Nightfall: Grant an enemy Vulnerable and give enemies -1|-0 this round. Other allies have Fearsome. When you summon another ally, give enemies -1|-0 this round.

name: Lulu (level 2)
text: Keywords: Support. Round Start: Create a Fleeting Help, Pix! in hand. Support: My supported ally grows up to 5|5 this round.

name: Dragon Shyvana (level 2)
text: Keywords: Fury. Attack: Give me +2|+2 this round and create a Fleeting 2 cost Strafing Strike in hand.

name: Trundle (level 2)
text: Keywords: Overwhelm, Regeneration. When I'm summoned, create an Ice Pillar in hand. Attack: Grant me +1|+0 for each 8+ cost card you Behold.

name: Ekko (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. Strike: Create a Fleeting 0 cost Time Trick in hand.

name: Pyke (level 2)
text: Keywords: Lurk, Quick Attack. When I Lurk, transform me into Death From Below. When I kill an enemy, I strike the weakest enemy.

name: Irelia (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack, Attune. When I'm summoned or Round Start: If you have the attack token, create a Flawless Duet in hand. When allies attack, create a Bladesurge in hand.

name: Rek'Sai (level 2)
text: Keywords: Lurk, Overwhelm. When I level up, create 3 random Lurkers in hand. When I Lurk or Attack: Grant Lurker allies everywhere +1|+0.

name: Zilean (level 2)
text: Round Start: Create a Fleeting copy of each non-Fleeting card I saw you play last round. Play: Create 4 Time Bombs in your deck, then Predict.

name: Taliyah (level 2)
text: Play: Summon an exact copy of an allied landmark. Attack: I deal 2 damage to my blocker 3 times. If it's dead or gone, I deal 2 damage to the enemy Nexus instead.

name: Azir (level 2)
text: When I level up, replace your deck with the Emperor's Deck, then draw 1. When allies attack, summon an attacking Sandstone Charger.

name: Azir (other form)
text: When allies attack, summon an attacking Sand Soldier. When you summon another ally, give us both +1|+0 this round.

name: Akshan (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. When I'm summoned or strike: Summon a Warlord's Hoard or advance it 1 round.

name: Renekton (level 2)
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. When I block or Attack: Deal 2 to enemies and the enemy Nexus.

name: Renekton (other form)
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. Attack: Give me +3|+3 this round.

name: Nasus (level 2)
text: Keywords: Fearsome, SpellShield, Missing Translation. I have +1|+1 for each unit you've slain this game. Enemies have -3|-0.

name: Sivir (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack, SpellShield. While I'm attacking, attacking allies have my keywords.

name: Lissandra (level 2)
text: Keywords: Tough, Missing Translation. Your Nexus is Tough. When I'm summoned, summon a Frozen Thrall and advance it 2. Round Start: Create a Fleeting 0 cost Ice Shard in hand.

name: LeBlanc (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. Each time you deal 15+ damage, create a Mirror Image in hand. If you already have one, reduce its cost by 1 instead.

name: Kindred (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. Each round, the first time you slay a unit, grant me +2|+2 and I mark the weakest enemy. Round End: Kill units with my mark.

name: Viego (level 2)
text: Keywords: Fearsome. Each round, the first time another unit dies, summon an Encroaching Mist. Round Start: Steal the strongest enemy this round. If it's a champion, kill it instead.

name: Malphite (level 2)
text: Keywords: Tough. Play: Stun an enemy. When I'm summoned or Round Start: If you have the attack token, create an Unstoppable Force in hand.

name: Jarvan IV (level 2)
text: Keywords: Barrier. When you attack, pay my cost to summon me Challenging the strongest enemy. Round Start: Create a Fleeting Cataclysm in hand. When I Challenge an enemy, give me Barrier this round.

name: Tristana (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack, Impact. I have +1|+0 for each multi-region ally you've summoned this game. When you summon a multi-region ally, grant me and it +1|+0 and Impact.

name: Mega Gnar (level 2)
text: Keywords: Overwhelm, Quick Attack. When I level up, grant the strongest enemy Vulnerable. Round End: If I've seen you start the round with the attack token, transform me back into Gnar.

name: Yuumi (level 2)
text: Keywords: Attach, SpellShield. Round Start: Grant the unit I'm Attached to SpellShield and +1|+1. Otherwise, grant me SpellShield and +1|+1 instead.

name: Yuumi (other form)
text: Round Start: Grant me +1|+1.
